corrections: A t-table cell is a coordinate, not an upper-tail probability.
A t distribution has expectation zero only for df>1. Variance is df/(df-2) for df>2, infinite for 1<df<=2, and undefined for df<=1.
The supplied t-density expression is not copied: the textbook teaches the statistic and table, not the gamma-density calculation.
A chi-square sum about known mu has df=n; residual variation about an estimated mean has df=n-1.
Galton board: more beads improve empirical proportions; more rows change the binomial law and its normal approximation.
